dcterms:description: A synthetic dataset generated for training and evaluating the Insertion-Deletion Transformer model, consisting of sequences where each letter is shifted by a fixed amount in the alphabet.
dcterms:title: Shifting Alphabetic Sequences

dcterms:description: A synthetic dataset generated for training and evaluating the Insertion-Deletion Transformer model, based on Caesar's cipher where each letter in the source sequence is replaced by a letter some fixed number of positions down the alphabet.
dcterms:title: Caesar's Cipher
